defs.meaning: （使）相关联；（使）相互对照（correlate 的过去分词）

examples.en: Their ratings correlated strongly with students' end-of-semester ratings.
examples.zh: 他们的评分与学生学期末的评分密切相关。

examples.en: San Jose also performs poorly on some of the measures correlated with good mobility.
examples.zh: 圣何塞在一些与良好流动性相关的测量上也表现不佳。

examples.en: It is still in most cases closely correlated with educational attainment and career expectations.
examples.zh: 在大多数情况下，它仍然与教育程度和职业期望密切相关。
